name: Fody Foods Low FODMAP Steak Spice (Montreal Style, Onion & Garlic Free)
whyItWorks: Replaces commercial steak rubs that are 50% garlic and onion salt with a blend of coarse sea salt, coriander, crushed dill seed, and sweet paprika. Robust steakhouse flavor with zero fructan bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Press onto lean sirloin steak, chicken breast cutlets, or pork tenderloin medallions before pan-searing.
